author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: grip at the top-left with one cord dropping and turning up the long diagonal to a teardrop pouch at the top-right, a second cord from the grip's top bending into the pouch point, a loose tail to the lower-left, and a round stone bottom-right; follows the reference layout. The rejected drawing had crossing straight strokes and a heavy stone.
omissions: The grip is a single stroke rather than the reference's rounded handle (a closed handle 6 wide has no open centre at 48px); the cord is single-stroke instead of a double-edged strap.
drawing_plan: Grip (6,6)-(6,13); cord cubic to J (13,32); line J-P (22,20) and tail J-(7,40); top cord cubic (6,6)-P; pouch teardrop cubic from P over (34,6) and (42,12); stone r4 at (36,38).
lucide_reference: No Lucide sling; cubic cords and teardrop loop as in 'lasso', circle for the stone.
